method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces the pachanga basic step and demonstrates the whole routine. He breaks down the footwork, weight changes, and body posture systematically. Finally, he practices the steps to music.
method.signature: Emphasizing plastic doll body mechanics where upper and lower body move counter to each other.

practices.what: Performs full pachanga basic footwork in front of the mirror to music.
Explains cord beat basic timing (1, 3, 5, 7) with preparation on 'and'.
Breaks down weight shifting exercise from right to left with hip tracking.
Practices upper body and knee isolation moving forward and back.
Teaches foot drill learned from Adolfo opening knees and feet.
Puts all learned drills and basic steps together to music.

adaptations.difficulty: Doing heel toe movements while maintaining balance
adaptations.adjustment: Practice in jazz shoes first as it is easier than doing it in heels

beliefs.belief: Practicing at home helps you kill it when you go to workshops.

struggles.theme: Learning the basic step takes days and feels difficult
Understanding hip movements and weight changes is hard

clicked.theme: Tutorial breaks down movements clearly and accessibly

requests.theme: Asking for song title or more pachanga lessons

meant.theme: Helped salseros and instructors improve their dancing significantly

method.limits: Cannot show physical partner interaction or floor friction details.
